change.purpose: Operator requests 2026-10-07 after v1.9.2: (1) ChatGPT more often went into background processing ('Våra system bearbetar …') and then 'Anslutningen bröts. Väntar på hela svaret'; implement points 1-7 of the prompt analysis plus 5.1/5.2 against GFW_EIC_CONTROL_A2A_v1; (2) a queue rotation to a GFW at quantum interaction 1 re-entered an old session instead of a fresh EIC session; (3) work a GFW queues autonomously must land in the same Greenfield window as the ordering GFW; (4) every prompt must list the window's GF slots and schedules; (5) 'Operatör är aldrig närvarande i en GFW session': no path may wait for an operator.

before.promptSizing: One static planningHint for every interaction position; start objective '… then continue autonomously'; FULL queue prompts said 'Keep each response well inside this bound' (120 min); no sizing text without a queue; continuation objective written by the local Hjalmar D2 from a 260-char preview; pressureBand blind to completion/round-trip time (a 23-min turn reported LOW); no hot-reload reference; no contradiction lint; no per-turn prompt size telemetry.
before.transport: The processing notice was only stripped from answer text; the connection-lost banner was not recognised; prompts could be posted and partial answers captured while either was shown (operator screenshot: SENDING over 'Anslutningen bröts').
before.session: warmResumeDecision ignored the quantum position: in the operator export 4 of 7 warm resumes started a new quantum in the GFW's old chat (GF-007 at 1/5, its own conversation 6ac5c63d; no cross-GFW chat reuse occurred). Reproduced on 1.9.2 (verification/v193-negative-v192.tap).
before.delegation: Workers claimed only delegations from OTHER windows; GF-045's 'GF-007 P0-E …' and 'GF-061 Q3 …' landed in another window's queue (operator export).
before.localAnalysis: A local Hjalmar DONE closed a mission although the EIC said CONTINUE (also with ROTATE_SESSION_NOW/YIELD_TO_QUEUE); an unknown Nano result hard-blocked; a missing, downloadable or failing Chrome LanguageModel stalled analysis in recovery (backoff up to 6 h) and blocked the start; a consumed NANO_TASK line could be re-sent to the EIC; an EIC DONE with a pending operator instruction looped in recovery.
before.operatorDependency: An intermediate 1.9.3 build blocked for an operator after a repeated local DONE without EIC terminal (commit 1e4d23f); operator report 2026-10-07: no operator is ever present in a GFW session.

design.slicing: lib/interaction-slicing.mjs owns all sizing text: role from exact queue counters (FIRST/MIDDLE/FINAL_CHECKPOINT/SCHEDULE_CHECKPOINT/ONLY_INTERACTION/UNQUEUED), planningHint from the contract template plus a role clause, slicePressure (SHRINK on COMPLETION_HIGH_RELATIVE/COMPLETION_RISING/PROVIDER_BACKGROUND_PROCESSING/TRANSPORT_INTERRUPTED/TTFR_HIGH_RELATIVE/RECOVERY_CHURN or band ELEVATED+), objectiveGuard (heuristic multi-phase guard sentence, never rewrites the objective), methodControl (always-fetch owners + GFW_INTERACTION_SLICING_2026_10_07 + precedence rule) in FULL and a reminder in COMPACT; every 'fully in force' is subordinated to the current owner method. Stale-session text is derived from waiting-refresh constants and labelled as Greenfield's watchdog, not a provider limit or response budget. No TTL is stated or assumed.
design.controlChain: greenfield-control: structured EIC CONTINUE handoff forwarded verbatim without its NANO_TASK line (EIC_HANDOFF_FORWARDED); a local advisory DONE continues (ADVISORY_DONE_WITHOUT_EIC_TERMINAL) or follows an EIC BLOCKED; NANO_TASK_UNKNOWN_EFFECT is no longer a stop. hjalmar-d2: NEXT_INTERACTION input, rule 16, DONE requires the target's DONE; UNKNOWN_EFFECT continues without replay. offscreen: deterministic fallback when the local model is missing; a requested task is FAILED 'not executed'. sidepanel: the LanguageModel preflight is optional. Control-chain review fixes (commit 81ab9d6): a local DONE never closes with ROTATE_SESSION_NOW/YIELD_TO_QUEUE (CC-01); admission recovers only from the NANO-free handoff and removes a NANO_TASK directive instead of blocking (CC-02/CC-05, REPLANNED_NANO_TASK_DIRECTIVE_REMOVED); every LanguageModel failure, downloadable and downloading fall back to the runtime decision (CC-03); the EIC handoff is forwarded with a Nano task, READ_REQUIRED and rotation/yield (CC-04); the no-delta exit is queue-aware (CC-07); an EIC terminal with a pending operator instruction is deferred and the instruction rides on the next prompt (CC-08, EIC_TERMINAL_DEFERRED_FOR_OPERATOR_INSTRUCTION).
design.noOperator: No operator is present in a GFW session: a repeated local DONE without EIC terminal or handoff (ADVISORY_DONE_NO_DELTA_PAUSE) becomes a Greenfield-timed pause, 15 min doubling to 6 h (the recovery backoff shape): a queue slot is paused (ADVISORY_NO_DELTA_PAUSED, quantum progress kept) while the next runnable slot runs, otherwise a process pause (MISSION_PAUSE_ARMED, requestedBy GREENFIELD_NO_DELTA); afterwards the EIC is asked again with the pause number in the objective. An EIC handoff resets the streak; an EIC session control of its own takes precedence. Pre-existing BLOCKED outcomes (EIC BLOCKED, humanAuthorityRequired, rejected terminal target, local block without any EIC next step) are unchanged; queue slots retry them after the aging delay.
design.session: warmResumeDecision takes interactionInQuantum (queueContext.interactionCount + 1); interaction 1 or unknown -> cold NEW_QUANTUM_FRESH_CHAT (fresh chat, FULL SESSION_ROTATION, sessionSeq+1). Warm only for an unfinished quantum. QUEUE_ITEM_ACTIVATED records interactionInQuantum and a truthful freshChat.
design.delegation: claimPendingMissionDelegationForWorker claims PENDING and orphaned requests only for the source queue (stable sourceQueueId); the delegating worker wakes itself; insertion stays a separate worker tick. Prompt: missionDelegationControl.target SAME_WINDOW_GREENFIELD_QUEUE. Supersedes the contract's observed rule ANOTHER_LIVE_QUEUE_MANAGED_GREENFIELD_WORKER by operator intent (contract precedence #1).
design.windowQueue: lib/window-queue-overview.mjs: control.windowQueue in every FULL and COMPACT prompt (position, GF id, label, status, current slot with itemId, priority, quantum, schedule, next runnable time, delegation requestId); built from the in-memory queue at activation; COMPACT references the static rule.
design.transport: content.js providerTransportNotices: processing notice in short visible elements after the last user message while no substantive answer is visible; connection-lost banner (Swedish observed, English assumed) anywhere outside user messages, prose, code, forms and Greenfield UI. background: no post while shown (bounded by WAITING_GENERATION_LIMIT_MS), no capture of a partial answer (a complete schema-valid A2A answer wins over a lingering banner), the stale ladder/capacity hand-back/warm verdict/keepalive/interrupted-turn recovery treat them as pending; session-health pressure carried over rotation; incidents PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_NOTICE and PROMPT_DISPATCH_HELD_PROVIDER_NOTICE.
design.lintAndTelemetry: lib/prompt-lint.mjs checks Greenfield-authored text/structure against C01-C20 before every post (fail closed: A2A_PROMPT_LINT_FAILED); composeA2APrompt returns metrics; TURN_METRICS incident per captured turn (prompt chars, position, role, pressure, notices, timings; no text).

Operator rule 2026-10-07 'no operator in a GFW session' implemented (ADVISORY_DONE_NO_DELTA_PAUSE). claimBoundary.liveChatGPT: NOT_VERIFIED: no live ChatGPT session; the notices were verified on synthetic markup that follows the real DOM sample (2026-09-25) and the operator screenshot (2026-10-07). The English banner wording is an assumption.
claimBoundary.effectOnBackgroundProcessing: NOT_CLAIMED: whether smaller slices reduce ChatGPT background processing is to be measured with TURN_METRICS (contract successSignal); no provider TTL is known or claimed.
claimBoundary.contractConformance: Greenfield-side rules C01-C07, C12, C14, C16-C20 and fixtures F01-F20 have deterministic tests; receiver-side rules (C08-C11, C13, C15) are not prompt-text checks.
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: A slot with maxInteractions 1 now starts every activation in a fresh chat with a FULL prompt (more input tokens than 1.9.2's warm resume); a single-slot queue still continues in the same chat across quanta (no queue switch)
A stuck processing notice or connection banner holds posting and defers the stale ladder for up to 4 h from the post, like a stuck stop button
Delegations created by 1.9.2 that were already inserted elsewhere stay where they are; a pending delegation whose source queue no longer exists waits until that queue runs again
COMPACT prompts grow by about 1.7-1.8 k characters plus about 400 per queue slot (window overview)

A mission without a queue still stops in BLOCKED for the pre-existing reasons (EIC BLOCKED, humanAuthorityRequired, rejected terminal target, local block without any EIC next step); queue slots retry them automatically
A local DONE repeated without EIC terminal costs one extra prompt per no-delta cycle before each pause (15 min doubling to 6 h)
A copy over the same folder needs chrome://extensions 'Läs in igen'
